name: Camp Kippewa
description_short: An all-girls overnight camp on Lake Cobbosseecontee in Monmouth, Maine, with a 3½-week traditional camp, a 2-week traditional camp and a 2-week riding camp. Tuition covers ground transport from Newton MA, Rye NY and Portland ME, plus trips, linens and laundry.
activities: Horseback riding (equestrian add-on and riding camp)

sessions.name: 2-week riding camp – Third Session (younger, newer riders)

sources.note: 2027 Dates and Rates for the three programs, tuition inclusions, contact
Facility Rentals: 'in Monmouth, Maine, nestled on 60 acres along Lake Cobbosseecontee'
Home page: overnight camp for girls on Lake Cobbosseecontee since 1957

source.title: Dates & Rates | Camp Kippewa – Plan Your Summer Camp Experience in Maine  - Camp Kippea | All-Girls Camp in Maine

warnings: The page covers three programs (Camp Kippewa, Camp Kippewa Point, Kippewa Equestrian Academy), but each block is labeled only by format ('half season (3 ½ week) traditional camp', '2 week traditional camp', '2 week specialty riding camp'). Going by the intro's order, these are probably Camp Kippewa, Camp Kippewa Point and Kippewa Equestrian Academy, but the page doesn't confirm that.

Discounts: $250 off the 2-week programs if enrolled by November 15. Returning families get $50 off per year attended (or $100 if re-enrolled by September 30). There's also a $125 sibling discount. Listed prices are before discounts.
Extras: private tennis add-on costs $400. Equestrian add-on fees aren't listed.
Footer says © 2025, but the session dates are for 2027.
